formal_statement: ∀ (V : Type) [DecidableEq V] (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) (n : ℕ), (∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause V), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation F π ∧ π.length = n) ↔ (∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinKLine V), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinKRefutation 1 F π ∧ π.length = n)
plain_statement: For every CNF F and every n: F has a Res(+) refutation of exactly n lines (the system of L-pcx-012 to 048, semantic weakening) if and only if it has a Res(k,+) refutation with k = 1 (termwise weakening) of exactly n lines. So the termwise system at k = 1 is the system already studied, not a weaker one.
title: Res(1,+) is Res(+): refutations of the same length exist in both systems
